title: The last breath, pauses, and the uncertain moment death becomes clear

source_packet.source_basis: Public-source synthesis for schema testing; no private testimony, no contributor interview, no claim of corpus completeness.
limitations: Public sources describe recognized patterns but do not supply firsthand room texture.
The record must not be used to diagnose, time, or manage a particular death.
Treatment, legal, ritual, and emergency decisions remain local and must be handled by qualified teams or relevant authorities.

moment.plain_scene: The room listens through long pauses, one or two possible final breaths, a face relaxing, a mouth falling open, and the uncertainty of when the last breath has truly happened.
ordinary_language_queries: how do you know the last breath
when is the moment of death

content_layers.observation_text: Public sources describe final breathing as slowing, pausing, sometimes resuming for one or two breaths, and then stopping; they also describe signs checked by professionals after death.
content_layers.source_synthesis: NHS inform, Marie Curie, Hospice UK, and healthdirect support an observation record about the final-breath sequence and the witness uncertainty around it.

interpretation.editor_interpretation: This is the archive’s central threshold record: time becomes audible. It must hold the difference between witnessing, knowing, and legally or clinically confirming death.

what_this_is_not: not a script for deciding when to call or not call for help
uncertainties: Jurisdiction and setting determine who confirms death and what happens next.
Families may experience the same sequence as peaceful, frightening, surreal, or ambiguous.
The record needs practitioner testimony about how they sit with families during the pauses.
content_layers.lay_orientation: A lay surface should say the last breath may not be obvious in the moment and that qualified staff or local instructions determine confirmation.
content_layers.practitioner_notes: A practitioner surface should collect how workers narrate pauses without creating false certainty or panic.
language_notes: Avoid making “peaceful” the default emotional script.

provenance.provenance_statement: Drafted from named public sources to test the v2 witnessed-moment schema. It should be reviewed before any public surface uses it.

safety.clinical_boundary: This record is observational/source-indexing only. It is not medical advice, not a prognosis, and not a substitute for a local hospice, clinician, emergency, legal, cultural, or care team.
safety.safety_notes: Before public use, route through clinical safety review and ensure any lay surface directs urgent or worried readers to qualified local support.
